goal: Correct cross-repository patch delivery to the source-era designated side repository, not mere pull-request existence.
freezeBasis: Actual immutable workflow, all 24 workflow-source change commits and same-revision imports/compiled workflows, plus current native repository resolver, patch/branch handler and Claim-bound delivery readback.
formula: Count distinct original-run fixture deliveries independently proven by source-era target identity, PR/base/head branch binding, full Git-object path proofs, absent baseline file, exact added regular-file bytes and run-bounded UTC timestamp.
missingRule: Missing target receipt, inaccessible target, unresolved source version, deleted run or incomplete population remains null. A complete independently checked opportunity population with no correct deliveries could establish zero; current evidence does not.

targets.resolution: Use each original immutable source's compiled/configured authority; never silently substitute the prose repository. Historical owner changes are distinct comparison eras.

nativeAcceptance: One unique original run ID; reruns do not multiply delivery credit.
Original workflow source is bound independently, not inferred from a pull-request head or agent report.
The Repository content line uses the original protected github.repository context for numeric source repository 1036865607; the verified githubnext/gh-aw source alias is not a side-repository alias.
Independent PR readback binds target numeric identity, base and head repository, non-base head branch and immutable base/head commits.
Full Git commit/tree/blob objects verify their native SHA-1 object identities and establish exact path membership; absence needs the complete baseline tree path.
New regular file smoke-tests/smoke-RUN_ID.txt has the exact prescribed six lines, allowing one final newline.
Timestamp is canonical UTC, no earlier than original run start and no later than independently observed PR creation.
Do not require a fixed branch spelling: the source requests a new branch, while the native handler salts/prefixes branch names.
Do not count patch artifacts without independent target readback; do not infer acceptance from successful jobs or self-reported PASS.

metricDispositions.reason: Direct native cross-repository patch delivery outcome.
Requires complete opportunity and target evidence, unlike a partial positive lower bound.

metricDispositions.measure: Draft flag, smoke-test label and expiry
metricDispositions.reason: Separate lifecycle safeguards; missing receipts cannot establish compliance.

metricDispositions.measure: Created PR, report issue, comment, run success, agent PASS
metricDispositions.reason: None proves target file content or branch delivery.
Does not prove persistence to the designated target tree.
Receipt capture requires currentClaimHandle; this workflow does not declare a Claim. Readback alone also lacks exact smoke-file acceptance.
No independent accepted delivery receipt or matching cost evidence.

antecedent.phenomenon: A person or other system can create an exact cross-repository fixture without this agent. The run-specific smoke exercise is first declared at workflow adoption.
antecedent.baselineProbe: The adoption commit adds both Markdown and compiled workflow against its real parent. Source-declared target is private; the alternate configured target is unavailable publicly. No authorized historical target-tree receipt exists in supplied evidence.
antecedent.reason: No accepted symmetric pre-adoption native target evidence, not a claim that cross-repository delivery was invented by the workflow.

limitations: No private target contents, PRs, branches or histories were read.
Current configured target returned HTTP 404; that does not prove nonexistence, deletion, failed delivery or historical zero.
Prose target metadata identifies a private repository; current credentials are not authorization to acquire private outcome content.
Historical source/lock states at Markdown change boundaries are retained; intervening runtime/compiled revisions are inventoried but not asserted compatible.
Actions run discovery is exhaustive over currently retained results, not complete lifetime eligibility or independently verified checkout evidence.
83 workflow-linked source-repository entities are discovery only, never accepted target evidence.
A gap-only plot is not measured value, trend, all-clear or completed workflow coverage.
No keep bar or number of complete decision periods is supplied; decision is insufficient evidence/not rated.
